items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: Stella Stan was a hero to me. I mean, I can remember seeing him... I went to his funeral

ctx.x: Well, what did your parents think of it? Did they universally like it too? They did.

Some of them were not as musical as my father. But they all condoned it. I mean, I don't have any recollection of any of them thinking it was trash. You know, they all, to my recollection, thought of it highly. Of course, we did too. And I have... Oh, you're friends. Mm-hmm. As I say, we were a very dancing crowd. We sang and danced. And Stella Stan was a hero to me. I mean, I can remember seeing him. I had been away a great deal and I saw him about 12 years ago. And he hadn't seen me because he had been away and…
Well, among the things, back in the 20s, did most of them just think of something to go dance to and have a good time to it?
